Free/listed status re-verified 2026-09-27T15:52:21Z (UTC) with zero-cost list reads only: Cline public free catalogue, OpenRouter public /api/v1/models, Groq keyed /openai/v1/models, Gemini keyed models.list. Official limits and prices re-read the same session: ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits. rules.routes: free = no charge for this call (verified free list / free plan); subscription = draws a flat-fee plan's allowance (NOT free); metered = charged per token, character or credit against a funded key or prepaid balance.
rules.fallback: When the selected model is unavailable or limited, the router falls back automatically along the task candidate chain and records fallbackFrom. Owner, 28 Sep: the chain may include paid models (OpenRouter DeepSeek, MiMo) and Cline models. The router never ADDS a free-tier model whose billing is unverified (Gemini) as an automatic fallback, because it could be billed while recorded as free; fallbacks that existed before the router (task preExistingFallbacks) are kept exactly as they were, receipted with cost unknown.
rules.noCaps: V7: no in-app spending caps on OpenRouter or Jev. OpenRouter auto top-up stays OFF (owner). Exhaustion surfaces as a failure with the provider's reason.
rules.noReplay: A step that may already have succeeded (succeeded, timed out, termination unverified) is never run again under the same requestId; for a task with side effects, a failure after the request was sent never falls back.
rules.dataUse: Informational only. Owner, 28 Sep: 'it's all my data' - no routing decision is made on whether a provider trains on or retains prompts.
rules.unknownStaysNull: Unknown usage, balance or cost is null, never 0.

jev.decision.onExhausted: No free model gives a typed Jev decision: the step has no reflex and goes to voice.brain.

approval.guardian.onExhausted: ESCALATE to the owner; a free model never approves a command.

voice.brain.onExhausted: Say the brain is rate-limited; Jev fast path or cache only.

voice.stt.onExhausted: Fail visibly; ask the owner to type.

voice.tts.onExhausted: Show the reply as on-screen text.

video.narration.onExhausted: Stop on 429 and retry later; never switch to a paid voice.

film.narration.noFreeFallback: A different narrator voice is not an eligible substitute in an approved film.
film.narration.onExhausted: Stop and report the ElevenLabs failure; no other voice.

video.understand.pro.noFreeFallback: The pro tier had no fallback before E1; kept exactly as it was.
video.understand.pro.onExhausted: Fail visibly (the pro tier has no fallback).

vision.screen.onExhausted: Say the screen couldn't be read.

research.web.onExhausted: No research; the coach plans without it.

inbox.question.onExhausted: Show the matching conversations without an answer.

agent.hermes.onExhausted: Stop and report the Codex window reset time.

coding.noFreeFallback: No verified free model is trusted to edit code unattended.
coding.onExhausted: Wait for the Codex window to reset.

coding.router.onExhausted: Stop the coding role with every model's reason; the owner picks another runner. Text only: the orchestrator applies owned files and runs the tests.

photo.index.noFreeFallback: The photo index uses only its consented OpenRouter route (photo-index.ts); no automatic substitute.

vision.point.onExhausted: Say the pointer couldn't find it; nothing is clicked.

bridge.claude.noFreeFallback: The /__claude bridge answers as the Claude model its caller asked for; the caller (Hermes) keeps its own fallback chain.
bridge.claude.onExhausted: Return the Claude failure to the caller.

bridge.cline.onExhausted: Return the Cline failure to the caller; public or synthetic text only.

dream.nightly.noFreeFallback: No free model takes a whole night's digest (Groq's free tier allows 8,000 tokens a minute); the night is recorded as failed.
dream.nightly.onExhausted: Record the night as failed with the reason, never a quiet success.

cad.code.onExhausted: No CAD code this time; say which engines failed.

meeting.notes.onExhausted: No notes or draft this time; say which models failed (the transcript is kept).

voice.companion.noFreeFallback: A realtime voice session runs on the engine the owner connected; a free model is not a substitute.
voice.companion.onExhausted: Say realtime voice couldn't start; the free voice engine stays available.
